title: A whole-type model written as a graph of named nodes
description: A model with `model.kind == "graph"` describes an effect type as named nodes wired together, so a coupled structure (feedback, parallel paths) can be written where a single `chain` cannot. Every value a node carries states where it comes from, so a fitted law and a printed default are never confused for a measurement. `rows` accounts for every address the type's own printed page names. Checked by hand, the same way `inference.json` is.

sample_rate_hz.description: The rate the graph is drawn at. A candidate value, not a constant: a model at a different rate is a second model, compared like any other.

inputs.description: The names a caller feeds audio into, e.g. `in_l`, `in_r`.

outputs.description: Output name to the node id that produces it.

rows.description: Every address the type's printed effect list names, sorted into `bound` (some node value's `byte` reads it) or `fixed_at_power_on`. A `switch` row is always `fixed_at_power_on`, because a structural choice has no `map`.

type.description: The effect type the graph is a model of. Null for a graph drawn after every type -- the send path -- which has no printed page of its own, so its `rows` hold only the addresses it reads.

node.description: A node that consumes audio names it as `input` (one name) or `inputs` (several); a node that only produces a control signal, such as `lfo`, has neither. Every other key on the node is one of its values, and which values a kind requires is that kind's own list rather than this schema's.

kind.description: Closed. Each kind is drawn by exactly one module and carries its own required values; this file only fences the vocabulary, not the per-kind requirements.

source.description: `measured` names the takes a value was read from directly. `law` names the claim a value was fitted under, with `fitted_on` derived from that claim's own citations. `document` names a printed default, never derived.

value_spec.description: A value carried by a node. Exactly one of three shapes: `byte`+`map` (read from a written address every sample the graph is drawn), `value` (a constant), or `control`+`map` (read from another node's output every sample). Whichever shape, `source`, `rests_on` and `fitted_on` are required.

fitted_on.description: The union of what was declared directly ([directory, setting] pairs for a measured value) and what a stage derives from `rests_on` for a law: the citations of the claim it points at, resolved back to take directories through the ledger.
